lens: REPRODUCE AND DATE-SPLIT (verify-5-reproduce): re-implement the rule from its expr with the shared loader, recompute bets/games/CLV (all closes and close_ok, game-clustered CI)/ROI/date halves, check NaN and look-ahead, the baseline population, the close-source mix, and whether the second half means anything.
rule: First listed within 6 h AND listed EV >= 2.5%: (df.minToStartFirst<=360)&(df.ev>=0.025)
numbers_reproduced:
MATCHES THE BUILDER EXACTLY. Bets 122, games 43, per day 54.08 (study span 2.256 days). Listed EV mean 4.06%. CLV all closes 3.0126% on 64 closes / 31 games, 95% game-cluster CI [1.99%, 4.39%], beat the close 71.9%. CLV close_ok 3.364% on 52 closes / 27 games, CI [1.99%, 5.10%], beat 78.8%. ROI at first-listed price 3.75% on 118 settled / 42 games, CI [-16.2%, +23.7%] (no information). Date halves (cut after Oct 4, split_by_date): first half 79 bets / 32 games, CLV 2.704% on 52 closes / 23 games [1.46, 4.28], ROI 1.39% (75 bets); second half 43 bets / 11 games, CLV 4.348% on 12 closes / 8 games [3.00, 5.51], ROI 7.88% (43 bets, CI [-43.7, +30.0]). Builder's 'baseline CLV 1.41%' is NOT the whole log (that is +0.19% on 683 closes / 69 games): it is all 938 bets first listed within 6 h at any EV (256 closes / 66 games, CI [1.01, 2.02]). No NaN in minToStartFirst or ev (0 of 2080), so the mask drops nothing silently; both fields are first-look values (no look-ahead); no duplicate ids or (event,market,selection) rows; the 6 h guard universe in the rationale reproduces exactly (Vigilant-listed, -200..+130, PROP/MONEYLINE/SPREAD, EV>=2.5%: 121 bets, 29 within 6 h, 14 closes / 7 games CLV +2.38% [1.55, 4.23]; 24 h: 73 closes / 24 games +0.97% [-1.14, 3.18]).
DIFFERENCES (game-cluster bootstrap on the union of closes, 5000 resamples): rule vs the other <=6 h bets (EV<2.5%): +2.14 pts [1.09, 3.45] (64 vs 192 closes, 66 games; close_ok +2.57 [1.29, 4.28]); first half +1.90 [0.72, 3.50], second half +2.97 [1.12, 4.04] (12 vs 24 closes, 9 games). Rule vs the same EV bets first listed over 6 h: +2.30 [0.01, 4.91] (80 closes, 21 games; one-sided p 0.025); vs 6-24 h only: +2.01 [-0.29, 4.52] (78 closes, one-sided p 0.045); first half only +1.60 [-0.56, 3.92]; second half only rests on 3 closes in 2 games (CLV -9.46%), not interpretable. Rule vs all other bets: +3.11 [1.98, 4.48].
CLOSE SOURCES INSIDE THE RULE: 64 closes = 39 Tracker (read before the start; 33 labelled CNO's books or Vigilant's fair line, 5 unlabelled, 1 Novig's trades: mostly the same family of fair that listed the bet; only bets Tj placed have one) CLV 3.94% [2.32, 5.79] beat 87%; 20 Novig last trades CLV 1.08% [-0.60, 2.30] beat 40% (12 of the 20 are 1-2 trades, so the 8 with 3+ trades give 0.48% [0.03, 0.68], beat 37.5%, 5 games); 4 ESPN/DraftKings 3.85% [1.05, 7.37]; 1 Pinnacle 2.14%. Independent closes (ESPN, Pinnacle, Novig 3+ trades) = 13 closes / 10 games CLV 1.64% [0.59, 3.44]. All closes excluding Tracker: 25 closes / 15 games 1.57% [0.24, 2.80], beat the close only 48%. On Tracker closes CLV is almost the listed EV (EV 4.16%, CLV 3.94%, drift of the fair listing-to-close -0.2%); on the 16 closes of bets first listed within 15 min of the start CLV 4.37% vs EV 4.34% (mechanical: listing and close minutes apart, same fair). Against Novig's own trades 28% of the listed EV (1.08 of 3.91) was still there. Same-horizon control inside each source: Tracker 3.94% (39) vs 1.41% (62) for <=6 h EV<2.5%; ESPN 3.85% (4) vs 1.60% (50); Novig 3+ trades 0.48% (8) vs -0.57% (60): same direction in all three. Reweighting the rule's source means to the <=6 h baseline's source mix gives 2.82% (not a source-mix artifact).
ROBUSTNESS: leave-one-game-out CLV range 2.77%-3.57% (31 games); dropping the 5 most favourable games 2.21% [1.37, 3.29] (53 closes / 26 games); per-game mean CLV 3.26%, 26 of 31 games positive, t=5.08. Excluding bets first listed within 15 min of the start: 92 bets / 38 games, CLV 2.56% [1.35, 4.39] on 48 closes / 26 games (close_ok 3.10% [1.60, 5.21]; first half 1.97%, second half 4.35%); within 30 min: 2.53%; within 60 min: 2.94%. Excluding bets first seen in the study's first 30 min (left truncation): 117 bets, 3.07%. Smooth surface, not a spike: CLV rises steadily with a lower horizon cap (1440 min 1.91%, 720 2.82%, 360 3.01%, 240 2.88%, 180 2.70%) and with a higher EV floor (EV>=1% 2.00%, 1.5% 2.36%, 2% 3.01%, 3% 3.71%, 4% 4.05% at 360 min). Exact cluster sign-flip against the all-closes mean (0.19%): 1H p=0.0003 (23 games), 2H p=0.0078 (8 games; 7 of 8 positive, one exactly 0.0; the floor for 8 games is 0.0039, so the builder's 0.004 is the floor, not a strong p), all closes p<1e-5.
SECOND HALF IS ONE GAME DAY: cut day Oct 4 gives first half = bets first seen Oct 3-4 and second half = bets first seen Oct 5 (plus 11 bets on Oct 6, none in the rule): all 11 rule games in it started on Oct 5 (afternoon and evening). 20 of its 43 bets (47%) are one game (ATL@NO, 3 closes). 9 of its 12 closes are Tracker closes (CNO's books), 3 ESPN. The whole second half was better for every <=6 h bet (<=6 h any EV: 2.37% on 36 closes / 9 games vs 1.25% first half; <=6 h EV<2.5%: 1.38% on 24 closes), so 2.70 -> 4.35 says little about the rule itself. In the whole log's second half only 65 of 612 bets (10 games) have a close.
reason: Provisional yes, as a QUESTION for Tj, not an action. The numbers reproduce exactly, the mask has no NaN or look-ahead problem, and I could not make the effect go away: it survives leave-one-game-out and dropping the best 5 games (2.2%), dropping bets first listed within 15-60 min of the start (2.5-2.9%), re-weighting to the baseline's close-source mix (2.8%), and it points the same way inside every close source and on both date halves (+1.9 and +3.0 pts over the other <=6 h bets). Tightening the guard to 6 h is also the safe direction (it cuts the auto-bet universe from 121 to 29 bets, 24%), the app's code default is already 6 h (TrapGuard.DEFAULT_EARLY_HOURS) and the phone's file shows 24 h, and the 6 h figure came from Tj's own earlier bets, not tuned on this file. BUT the new part (6 h instead of 24 h) is only weakly shown: matched against 6-24 h bets at EV>=2.5% the gain is +2.0 pts with a CI [-0.3, 4.5] (78 closes in 21 games), the second half contributes just 3 closes in 2 games to that comparison, and 61% of the rule's closes are Tracker closes read from the same CNO/Vigilant fair that listed the bet (CLV there is about the listed EV by construction when the horizon is short), while the independent closes are 13 in 10 games (1.64%) and Novig's own trades keep only 28% of the EV. The second half (12 closes, 8 games, one game day) cannot confirm anything on its own: it is consistent, not out-of-sample proof. ROI (3.75%, CI -16 to +24) is silent. What would settle it: about 60+ independent (ESPN/Pinnacle/Novig 3+ trades) closes on bets listed within 6 h at EV>=2.5% across 30+ games on at least 3 separate game days, versus the same count for the 6-24 h arm; at the rule's 54 logged bets/day with a close on about half (and independent closes on about one in five of those) that is roughly 10 or more days of logging; ROI would need hundreds of games.
caveats: Builder's 'baseline CLV 1.41%' is the <=6 h any-EV population (938 bets), not the whole log (0.19% on 683 closes); the whole-log baseline makes the rule look like +2.8 pts, its own timing baseline +1.6 pts, the same-horizon low-EV control +2.1 pts [1.1, 3.5].

Only 64 of 122 rule bets have a close (52% vs 33% in the whole log) and 39 of those 64 are Tracker closes, which exist only for bets Tj/the auto-bet placed (39 of the 40 placed bets): the closed subset is a selected one (passed the sharp check and 3+ agreeing books). The 58 rule bets with no close had ROI +31% and the 64 closed ones -20% (noise at this size, but a reminder that results and CLV come from different bets).

Tracker closes are CNO's books or Vigilant's fair line read just before the start, the same family of fair that produced the listed EV: against it the rule's CLV (3.94%) equals its listed EV (4.16%); it measures whether the soft-book consensus stayed put, not whether a sharp book agrees. Only 5 sharp-ish closes (4 ESPN/DraftKings, 1 Pinnacle) exist in the rule.

Bets first listed within 15 min of the start (30 of the 122; 16 closes) have CLV 4.37% about equal to their EV because the close is minutes after the listing; excluding them leaves 2.56% [1.35, 4.39] (48 closes, 26 games).

Second half = Oct 5 only (11 rule games, 8 with a close); 47% of its bets are one NFL game; 9 of 12 closes are Tracker. The loader split and 'second half above its own mean' are not a genuine out-of-sample test of a rule that was chosen while looking at the whole 2.26 days. The sign-flip p of 0.004 is the minimum possible with 8 games (mine: 0.0078 against the all-closes mean).

Versions 0.57.0 to 0.68.0 and the trap-guard window (6/12/24 h in the file's own skip counts: 303 skipped at '>6 h', 151 at '>12 h', then 24 h on the phone) changed during the log, so the placed bets (Tracker closes) at 6-24 h exist only because the guard was loosened for part of the period.

Size: median Novig dollars available at the first-listed price is $71 (mean $401, pulled up by a few deep books); 30% of the rule's bets have under $20 and 47% under $50; only 70% of the 40 placed bets were placed at the first-listed price. The 54 bets/day is a count of logged bets, not stake the phone could place; per-day for the auto-bet's own universe is 12.9 of 53.6.

Multiple testing: the builder tried 9340 rule-yardstick combinations; its family-wise p (0.007-0.009) is not re-run here (verify-5-luck owns it). The rule sits on a smooth plateau (neighbouring horizons and EV floors give 2.7-4.1%), the EV floor 2.5% is the app's pre-existing setting and 6 h is the app's default, which argues against a lucky pick of cut-points.

Any change to which bets are placed is Tj's decision; this one tightens the trap guard (fewer bets), it does not loosen a limit. Proposal for Tj: keep the guard at 6 h (the code default) rather than 24 h, and let the log collect independent closes before treating the +2 pts as proven.
